Resources.name: QvmAssemble
Resources.note: Assemble QAS assembler file, Params: Assemler source file like 'objects.qas'

Resources.name: QvmCompile
Resources.note: Compile qvm file loaded in memory, Params: address of QVM file loaded from 'LoadResource' method.

Resources.name: QvmLoad
Resources.note: Compiles and Load any .qvm file into memory, Params: any qvm file name,  Returns filename loaded.

Resources.name: QvmParse
Resources.note: Parse Assembler source file, Params: any QAS file name and Memory allocated by Mem_Alloc(),  Returns status.

Resources.name: ResourceFlush
Resources.note: Releases the current holding resources, Params: Params: p1 ??

Resources.name: ResourcePackUnpack
Resources.note: Packs and return address or Unpacks resource file into memory depending upon resource type, Params: resource 'sounds.res','terrain.res', and buffer.

Resources.name: ResourceUnpack
Resources.signature: void ResourceUnpack(int* res_ptr, int res_addr, int res_size);
Resources.note: Unpacks resource file into memory, Params: Resource ptr, address where to unpack (Allocate using Mem_Alloc) and size of resource.
